scope: 40 additional reference templates, not integrated desktop renderers

charts.name: Ridgeline plot
charts.definition: Overlapping density curves compare distributions.

charts.name: Q–Q plot
charts.definition: Sample quantiles against theoretical quantiles reveal distribution differences.

charts.name: P–P plot
charts.definition: Empirical and theoretical cumulative probabilities are compared against equality.

charts.name: ECDF plot
charts.definition: A staircase records the fraction of samples at or below a threshold.

charts.name: Forest plot
charts.definition: Points and horizontal intervals compare estimates and uncertainty.

charts.name: Error-bar plot
charts.definition: Interval endpoints around estimates show variability or uncertainty.

charts.name: Residual plot
charts.definition: Observed minus fitted values are plotted against fitted values.

charts.name: Autocorrelation plot
charts.definition: Correlations with lagged copies of a series reveal persistence.

charts.name: Partial autocorrelation plot
charts.definition: Lagged correlation after controlling for shorter lags helps identify autoregressive order.

charts.name: Lag plot
charts.definition: Observations are plotted against earlier observations.

charts.name: Bode plot
charts.definition: Gain and phase appear on aligned logarithmic frequency axes.

charts.name: Nyquist plot
charts.definition: A complex frequency-response trajectory reveals feedback behavior.

charts.name: Smith chart
charts.definition: Complex reflection coefficient maps onto a normalized impedance grid.

charts.name: Nichols chart
charts.definition: Gain in decibels is plotted against phase in degrees.

charts.name: Root locus plot
charts.definition: Closed-loop poles trace paths as feedback gain changes.
charts.caution: Declare gain range and feedback convention.

charts.name: Spectrogram
charts.definition: Color represents signal power or magnitude by time and frequency.

charts.name: Power spectral density
charts.definition: Power per frequency bandwidth is plotted against frequency.

charts.name: Quiver plot
charts.definition: Arrows encode vector direction and magnitude at spatial points.

charts.name: Streamline plot
charts.definition: Curves follow instantaneous vector-field directions.
charts.caution: Not necessarily particle paths in unsteady flow.

charts.name: Contour plot
charts.definition: Lines connect equal scalar values.

charts.name: 3D scatter plot
charts.definition: Points occupy three coordinate axes.

charts.name: 3D surface plot
charts.definition: A response surface maps two input variables to one output.

charts.name: 3D mesh plot
charts.definition: Connected vertices and faces depict geometry or sampled surfaces.

charts.name: Isosurface plot
charts.definition: A surface marks equal values in a volumetric field.

charts.name: Ternary plot
charts.definition: Three nonnegative fractions summing to one occupy a triangle.

charts.name: Parallel coordinates
charts.definition: Each record connects multiple parallel variable axes.

charts.name: Scatterplot matrix
charts.definition: A grid displays pairwise scatterplots and diagonal distributions.

charts.name: Carpet plot
charts.definition: Two families of parameter curves form a response grid.

charts.name: Polar plot
charts.definition: Angle and radius encode directional values.
charts.caution: Declare angular origin and radial units.

charts.name: Icicle chart
charts.definition: Nested rectangles encode hierarchical quantities by depth.

charts.name: OHLC bar chart
charts.definition: High-low lines carry left-open and right-close ticks.

charts.name: Fan chart
charts.definition: Nested uncertainty intervals depict forecasts over time.
charts.caution: Scenarios are not probabilities without calibration.

charts.name: Horizon chart
charts.definition: Magnitude bands are folded into a compact colored time-series strip.

charts.name: Streamgraph
charts.definition: Multiple nonnegative series stack around a shifting baseline.

charts.name: Drawdown chart
charts.definition: Decline from a running peak is plotted as a percentage.

charts.name: Order-book depth chart
charts.definition: Cumulative bids and asks are plotted by price.

charts.name: Load duration curve
charts.definition: Descending power measurements are plotted against exceedance duration.

charts.name: Learning curve
charts.definition: Unit cost or performance is related to cumulative production.
charts.caution: Cumulative output is not calendar time.

charts.name: Pareto frontier
charts.definition: Nondominated options show trade-offs between competing objectives.

charts.name: Network graph
charts.definition: Nodes and edges represent entities and relationships.
charts.caution: Layout distance need not be physical.
